body:
Also encountered in C# projects using .NET's multi-threading APIs.

Happened when ShaderMaterial is disposing on game quiting:
```
Unloading: Disposing tracked instances...
ERROR: Parameter "material" is null.
   at: material_set_shader (servers\rendering\renderer_rd\storage_rd\material_storage.cpp:2250)
   C# backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] void Godot.GodotObject.Dispose(bool) (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\GodotObject.base.cs:137)
       [1] void Godot.GodotObject.Dispose() (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\GodotObject.base.cs:108)
       [2] void Godot.DisposablesTracker.OnGodotShuttingDownImpl() (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\DisposablesTracker.cs:49)
       [3] void Godot.DisposablesTracker.OnGodotShuttingDown() (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\DisposablesTracker.cs:17)
ERROR: Parameter "material" is null.
   at: material_set_shader (servers\rendering\renderer_rd\storage_rd\material_storage.cpp:2250)
   C# backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] void Godot.GodotObject.Dispose(bool) (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\GodotObject.base.cs:137)
       [1] void Godot.GodotObject.Dispose() (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\GodotObject.base.cs:108)
       [2] void Godot.DisposablesTracker.OnGodotShuttingDownImpl() (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\DisposablesTracker.cs:49)
       [3] void Godot.DisposablesTracker.OnGodotShuttingDown() (C:\xxx\godot\modules\mono\glue\GodotSharp\GodotSharp\Core\DisposablesTracker.cs:17)
...
```

(The size of the log file can reach over 800G !)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b2c0acae-52fc-482d-b139-3bb06a523acd)
I note that this is still present on current master
@nikitalita Can you test with https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/116203 and confirm if it helps in your case.

Retest with #116203, as asked on 2026-05-25, using a materials-only reproduction: no meshes, no assets, no scene tree.

`StandardMaterial3D`s created, duplicated and bound with `get_rid()` on `WorkerThreadPool` threads, while the main loop runs normally, give this issue's endless `Parameter "material" is null` at `material_set_shader` on 4.6.1, plus signal 11 crashes:

| engine | runs | result |
|---|---|---|
| 4.6.1.stable | 6 race runs | 6 of 6 failed: 3 crashes (signal 11), 3 `material is null` floods that never finish |
| 4.6.1.stable | 4 controls (`--mode=noop`, `--no-rid`) | all clean |
| 4.7.2.stable | 34 | all clean, including 14 runs of the hardest case (`--mode=drop --nw=1`), 12 of them with the machine deliberately loaded |

So on Forward+ this looks fixed by #116203 in 4.7. Runs were on Linux with Mesa lavapipe (CPU Vulkan, Forward+) under Xvfb; the pattern was first seen on an RTX 3060 Ti in a game project. Not tested: 4.6.2, 4.6.3, or 4.7.2 on a real GPU.

One thing #116203 may not cover. With an earlier copy of the script, 1 of 6 runs on 4.7.2 flooded this alternating pair, and it did not recur in the 34 later runs:

```
ERROR: Condition "p_elem->_root != this" is true.
   at: remove (./core/templates/self_list.h:80)
ERROR: Condition "p_elem->_root" is true.
   at: add (./core/templates/self_list.h:46)
```

From reading the source (not a debugger): `BaseMaterial3D::~BaseMaterial3D()` doesn't take `material_mutex`, but its `SelfList` element is unlinked by `SelfList::~SelfList()` with no lock, while `flush_changes()` walks the dirty list. A material freed on a worker thread could race that, which would fit the pair above.

Run with a real renderer (not `--headless`, which is the Dummy renderer, #124183):

```
godot --path . --resolution 160x90 --script res://race.gd -- --mode=drop --nw=1
```

Healthy output ends with `frame 450` and `race finished`. Also try `--mode=keep --nw=1` and `--mode=keep --nw=2`; controls: `--mode=noop`, `--no-rid`.

<details><summary>project.godot</summary>

```ini
config_version=5

[application]

config/name="material_race_mrp"

[debug]

file_logging/enable_file_logging=false
```

</details>

<details><summary>race.gd</summary>

```gdscript
extends SceneTree
## Minimal reproduction: StandardMaterial3Ds are created, edited, duplicated and bound to the RenderingServer
## (get_rid()) on WorkerThreadPool tasks while the main loop runs normally (the engine calls
## BaseMaterial3D::flush_changes() itself before every draw). Nothing here touches the scene tree or a mesh.
##
## Run (a real renderer is needed, not --headless; any Vulkan Forward+ device works, software Vulkan too):
##   godot --path . --script res://race.gd -- [--mode=drop|keep|noop] [--nw=N] [--no-rid]
##
##   --mode=drop   the temporaries die on the worker that made them (default)
##   --mode=keep   every material is kept alive and only released later, on the MAIN thread
##   --mode=noop   the tasks do nothing (control: the script itself is clean)
##   --nw=N        elements per group task (default 6); a new group task is queued every 5 frames
##   --no-rid      skip get_rid() (control: no RenderingServer material is created for the bound one)
##
## Prints "frame N" every 50 frames and "race finished" when it ends normally (450 frames), so a hang or a
## flood of errors is visible as the heartbeat stopping or the log growing.
var mode := "drop"
var NW := 6
var ITER := 100
var no_rid := false
var frames := 0
var tasks: Array[int] = []
var keep: Array = []
var mutex := Mutex.new()


func _initialize() -> void:
	for a in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if a.begins_with("--mode="): mode = a.trim_prefix("--mode=")
		if a.begins_with("--nw="): NW = int(a.trim_prefix("--nw="))
		if a == "--no-rid": no_rid = true
	print("race mode ", mode, " nw ", NW, " no_rid ", no_rid)


func _work(_i: int) -> void:
	if mode == "noop": return
	var local: Array = []
	for k in ITER:
		var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
		m.albedo_color = Color(0.1 + 0.001 * k, 0.5, 0.5)
		m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA_SCISSOR
		var m2 := m.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
		m2.albedo_color = Color(0.5, 0.2 + 0.001 * k, 0.5)
		if not no_rid:
			m2.get_rid()
		var m3 := m2.duplicate() as StandardMaterial3D
		m3.distance_fade_mode = BaseMaterial3D.DISTANCE_FADE_PIXEL_DITHER
		if mode == "keep":
			local.append_array([m, m2, m3])
	if mode == "keep":
		mutex.lock(); keep.append_array(local); mutex.unlock()


func _process(_d: float) -> bool:
	frames += 1
	if frames % 50 == 0:
		print("frame ", frames)
	if frames % 5 == 1 and frames < 400:
		tasks.append(WorkerThreadPool.add_group_task(_work, NW, NW, true))
	for t in tasks.duplicate():
		if WorkerThreadPool.is_group_task_completed(t):
			WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_group_task_completion(t)
			tasks.erase(t)
	if mode == "keep" and frames % 10 == 0:
		mutex.lock(); keep.clear(); mutex.unlock()   # released on the MAIN thread
	if frames >= 450 and tasks.is_empty():
		print("race finished")
		return true
	return false
```

</details>
